comments.text:
Created attachment 2621
Translation of more char arrays in /library/*/src

Follow-up to 17818:

https://bugs.r-project.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=17818

Identified with regex:

> # exclude lines starting with { or *, and only include char arrays length >=
> 5
> grep -Enr  '^\s*[^*{ ].*"[^"]{5,}"' src/*.c --exclude=src/init.c | \
>   # exclude translated char arrays and messages denoting internal errors
>   grep -Fv '_("' | grep -Fiv "internal error" | \
>   grep -Ev "#\s*(?:include|define)" | \
>   # easily-identified lines where " is in a comment
>   grep -Ev '(?://|/[*]).*".*"|".*".*[*]/' | \
>   # laundry list of other functions taking literal char arrays
>   grep -Ev
>   "\b(?:strn?cmp|streql|strn?cpy|strcat|R_FindSymbol|inherits|mkChar|mkString|getenv|install|inherits|getFunc|getListElement|Prt_xtrVars|MSG|R_RegisterCCallable|InvalidExpression|BadUnitsError|setuserfilter|GetProcAddress|UNIMPLEMENTED_TYPE)\b"

There's a lot in stats/src/model.c being sent untranslated through Rprintf -- I left that be for now. Ditto for stats/src/fexact.c's prterr()s, parallel/src/fork.c's Dprintf()s, grDevices/devPS.c's fprintf()s, and methods/src/methods_list_dispatch.c's check_single_string()s.

Created attachment 2622
Fixing untranslated char arrays in src/library/*/src

Earlier patch was too aggressive as the _ alias is not always defined. In some cases, I defined it, in others, not (somewhat arbitrarily).

The biggest culprit was files in stats/src, is there any reason not to add the _ alias in stats.h instead of individually? Currently it's defined in 25 (21 .c, 4 .h) of the 62 files (56 .c, 6 .h).

Created attachment 2623
Fixing untranslated char arrays in src/library/*/src [III]

Just noticed this in R-ints:

> Messages for the ‘RGui’ domain are marked by G_("msg")... The list of files
> that are considered... includes devWindows.c

And indeed G_( macro is used a lot (57 times by my count) in src/library/grDevices/devWindows.c, but _( is also used a lot -- I couldn't discern a pattern of when to use _( vs G_( in this file.

In the attached, I at least tried to be consistent on _( vs G_( within each function (defaulting to _( if my edits were the first translations in that function). Any more rigorous guidance here would be helpful.

Thanks a lot for finding all of these untranslated strings. It makes sense to move the `_` definition to a central place, where feasible. Right now the patch needs a lot of clean up, because it appears to be modifying whitespace in lines where no actual change was made.
